title: v1.2 A-I3 LLM Runtime Transport Config
description: Connection/runtime details and the backend runtime identity: which endpoint to reach, which environment variable holds the credential (or null), the timeout, and the backend model actually requested (request_model) plus its provider_family. Must not contain result-affecting generation semantics (temperature, reasoning, prompt version, output-token budget). request_model / provider_family are backend routing + provenance identity, NOT the A-I3 semantic/reuse identity, so changing them does not invalidate reuse. Never includes the credential value itself.

request_model.description: Exact backend model identifier sent in the provider request body's model field and recorded in the invocation provenance. Backend routing identity, not part of the semantic/reuse identity.

provider_family.description: Backend family label recorded in the invocation provenance (e.g. qwen). Backend runtime identity, not part of the semantic/reuse identity.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint prefix. Must be http(s) with a hostname, no embedded credentials, and a path of exactly /v1 (the adapter appends /chat/completions). The schema pins the coarse shape; Python validation is authoritative for a valid port, well-formed IPv6, and no query/fragment.
